passed: No table, role=table, or role=grid in the in-scope templates
No sortable column, so aria-sort is not required
No complex header, colspan, or rowspan association
State directory and flood-alert empty results use a text message
Directory filters announce the visible count or an empty message in a polite live region
Station card metric labels remain in the DOM when the grid reflows
Home trend lists show a text empty message
Map station list is a ul of links with a text empty state
notes: No table is in scope. Home, map, alerts, the Washington state directory, content pages, and subscriptions/new.html.erb contain no table element, caption, th, or aria-sort, so findings is empty.

States::LocationsTableComponent, rendered by app/views/states/show.html.erb and app/views/alerts/show.html.erb, is a card list. Each metric is a text label followed by its value in .card-metrics. That is not a column-aligned div table, so caption, scope, and aria-sort rules were not applied as failures.
Home stats and the state and alert hero counts are separate label-and-value cards. Trend and popular regions are lists. They were not treated as data tables.
Gauge measurement tables in Gauges::MeasurementsComponent and the hydrograph table view are rendered from app/views/gauges/show.html.erb only. That template was out of scope and was not audited.
Code review only. Filter announcements and the map station list, built in app/javascript/controllers/map_controller.js outside the file list, were read from source and not run in a browser.
